articles.title: First Yamal hat-trick helps Liga leaders Barcelona beat Villarreal
articles.summary: Teenage star Lamine Yamal scored his first career hat-trick, leading Barcelona to a commanding 4-1 victory over Villarreal. This win propelled the Catalan giants four points clear at the top of Spain's La Liga. The impressive performance from the young talent highlights significant developments in European football, a part of broader international news.

articles.title: Barcelona 4-1 Villarreal: Report, result and goals as Yamal scores historic hat-trick
articles.summary: Barcelona secured a dominant 4-1 victory over Villarreal, moving four points clear of Real Madrid at the top of LaLiga. The win was spearheaded by a historic hat-trick from star player Lamine Yamal, his first in the league. This crucial performance further solidified Barcelona's position in the Spanish top-flight football league standings.

articles.title: Nine rusted mortar shells found in LoC village in Poonch
articles.summary: Nine rusted mortar shells were discovered in a forward village near the Line of Control (LoC) in Mendhar sector, Poonch district, Jammu and Kashmir. The find on Saturday by officials highlights the persistent threat of unexploded ordnance in border areas, a critical concern for local residents and security forces. Such discoveries often prompt cautionary measures.
